title: So disappointing, listen to this video of the horrible sound!
text:
So disappointing, listen to this video of the horrible sound!. [[VIDEOID:8b068b0714331c8333448858dc6dc32]] This comforter makes a horrible noise. You will wake up if someone crawls in bed beside you. That may be good or bad depending on your mood. But, I found this to be an unbearable constant sound with any movement in bed. There is some type of material inside that feels and sounds horrid. The outer material is fine and the sewing is great.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
